# Server Rules
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 1: Final admin rulings are FINAL.[/color][/head] While you may wish to debate a rule, prosecution is not the time for that. It is NOT arguing to provide additional context that makes what looked bad sound better, but it IS arguing to be angry at the admins for doing their job.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 2: Be normal.[/color][/head] Characters can have mental disorders, but that shouldn't mean they can attack everyone and get away scot-free. The Foundation would not hire someone so unstable. Your character could be depressed, have crippling anxiety, or be oblivious to a few certain things, and the Foundation would likely still hire them, assuming they had the knowledge to do their job.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 3: Do your job.[/color][/head] Do not abandon the game and your character because something didn't go your way. Essentially, do not leave if you don't get an antagonist, do not quit your job minutes into the round, and do not be counter-productive to your own job, unless you're an antagonist and need to.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 4: Do not make yourself an antagonist.[/color][/head] Doing actions that only a person with ulterior motives should be doing without the proper role will result in punishment.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 5: Insanity is not an excuse.[/color][/head] Going "insane" does not exempt you from punishment for your actions. This rule is ignored if the insanity DOES actually update your role.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 6: No ERP.[/color][/head] Do not engage in Erotic Roleplay. Friendship and romance are both acceptable, but anything outright erotic is banned. This rule is ZERO TOLERANCE. You will be atomized on the spot.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 7: Do not discriminate.[/color][/head] Do not use slurs, hate speech, or be bigoted, racist / speciest, or sexist. This is a no tolerance rule.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 8: Do not threaten other players.[/color][/head] Threatening characters in-character is okay. Saying you're going to air strike the captain's real life house with a fighter jet is not.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 9: Do not make other players uncomfortable.[/color][/head] Unless you are pursuing antagonist objectives or doing something like a Security search and seizure, do not make other players uncomfortable. For example, it is acceptable to demand a character change uniforms, if you are Security, the uniform they are wearing is contraband, and you give them privacy. It is not acceptable to run around trying to strip people of their uniform and underwear. No tolerance.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 10: No meta communication or use of meta information.[/color][/head] Communication between players in the same round must not occur. It is fine to talk to other people and stream the game, as long as nobody that is gaining knowledge from it that they are using in the game. If you know things happening in the round before you joined, you are prohibited from joining. You may not use knowledge you learn while dead or critical, and dying completely will wipe your memory of the circumstances of your death. No-tolerance rule.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 11: Ban evasion is bad, mkay kids?[/color][/head] Do not use alternative accounts, VPNs, or other methods to try to evade a ban. Zero tolerance, you will be gunned down by a firing squad if you break this rule.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 12: Please speak English.[/color][/head] This is a high-tolerance rule, meaning it is very flexible. The fork is being translated from Russian to English, so the presence of other languages is acceptable, but try to use English at all times. Made-up languages, such as Ratvarian are acceptable, as long as you do not use them for metacomming.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 13: Metafriending and Metagrudging are not allowed.[/color][/head] Do not give someone special treatment or extra shit because you like or don't like them.
[color=green][bold]Acceptable[/bold][/color] Being an exceptionally friendly person. Being slightly rude to everyone. Going out of your way to talk to people your character has become friends with. Refusing minor requests of those your character dislikes.
[color=red][bold]Unacceptable[/bold][/color] Maintaining a grudge for more than five rounds. A refusal or excitement to do things that impedes the round due to the requester. Getting into a brawl with a character on sight because you were mad at each other last round. Doing things you wouldn't do for another player in the same exact position as the requester character.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 14: No cheating.[/color][/head] This is a no-tolerance rule. Do not use external soft/hardware to gain an advantage over or do things that are impossible for fair players.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 15: Do not try to abuse or avoid Ahelp.[/color][/head] This is no-tolerance. Spamming Ahelp clogs up the information admins recieve, and avoiding Ahelp will make admins assume you are guilty.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 16: Do not threaten other players with administrative actions if you are not an administrator, and do not argue about rules with players.[/color][/head] You may not at any time mention the use of Ahelp to another player in a negative way. For example, you may not say you will Ahelp a player if they don't do what you say, and you may not taunt them by saying you ahelped them. You may point a new player to Ahelp if they witness an action against the rules.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 17: Use realistic, non-famous names for your characters.[/color][/head] You must use a name that makes sense for a person to have. Species-specific naming rules may be used for any species, but must fall within all rules. Additionally, do not use "meta" names such as Urist McHands, Operator Whiskey, and young man. Acceptable names include Licks-Their-Wounds, Albert Mason, and Sergey Xenia. Unacceptable names include bingleshitfuckhead, Adolf Hitler, John Wick, Mario Mario, and Bans-the-Antags.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 18: Do not use OOC chat to share information about the round.[/color][/head] Do not share information that the metacomms rule would not allow you to share in the OOC chat. Things like antagonist actions or statuses may not be disclosed.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 19: Silicons must follow their laws.[/color][/head] Silicons must follow their laws, from lowest to highest number, or top to bottom if no number is provided. Silicons may ignore certain rules that are not classified as no-tolerance in favor of their laws. If you have no laws, you are beheld to little other than the no-tolerance rules.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 20: Familiars must follow their owner(s).[/color][/head] As a familiar, you are beheld to your master's wishes. Obviously, your master wouldn't want to end up dead or in cuffs, so don't randomly attack them or others. If they demand something of you, you MUST attempt it to the best of your ability. You will not be faulted for trying to follow your master's commands if you don't know their antagonistic status and they demand an antagonistic action of you.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 21: Do not purposefully extend the round as a means of meta-warfare.[/color][/head] This rule sounds really funny out of context, but it means to not try to stall a round far past a reasonable amount. It is assumable you're trying to stall until the other players give up so you can get an easy victory. Allowable examples are delaying a round end because there are multiple breached SCPs that need to be contained. Not allowed is stealing the communications console to prevent evacuation, both automatic and manual.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 22: Antagonists should work with their team, if they have one.[/color][/head] Do not give Security information about other antagonists that you are affiliated with, unless it is part of a plan to actually help the team. Do not shoot the other members of your Insurgency strike team the second you spawn, or try to solo the site, either.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 23: Follow reasonable orders from your superiors.[/color][/head] Members of departments should listen to their head, and members of strike teams should listen to the Commander. This can be refused if the order is stupid. For example, the Complex Director can order the other heads to make sure they have everything from their lockers with them at all times. The Chief Technical Specialist would not be allowed to order an engineer to do something against the rules, but neither side would be faulted if the CTS demanded for the engineer to constantly report their status every minute to the CTS.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 24: Escalate reasonably.[/color][/head] Do not escalate beyond a reasonable amount when in conflicts. It must be GRADUAL. A security officer can't whip out a shotgun and gore someone's brains all over the wall because the person said "fuck you." They CAN argue until they get in a brawl, at which point the officer could non-lethally detain the aggressor.
[head=3][color=yellow]Rule 25: Have a reason for wanting things.[/color][/head] A character may want something, sometimes. This is reasonable. For example, a Class-D can ask a security officer for a hair-bow to feel pretty, and the officer may oblige. A scientist may not, however, break into Security and print a shotgun "just in case." If your argument contains "just in case" when asking for something, you probably shouldn't be given it.
